race.comment: OF THE VIEW (3) met with solid support last start over 1300m at Armidale when seventh, beaten 7 lengths. Rates highly and expected to atone. REVAMPED (1) has put together back-to-back placings, the latest when 2 lengths away in third over 1220m at Lismore when he was in the firing line all the way. Has the ability to take care of this field. BANXI (6) finished out of the money two starts back then was beaten 3 lengths when seventh over 1200m at Dubbo three weeks ago. Beautifully placed and is sure to play a major role. BUCKO'S WISH (8) missed the placings two runs back then improved last start but found a couple better over 1300m at Armidale, beaten 4 lengths. Looks to be in the right race so another bold effort is on the cards.
